title: Culturally-Aware GenAI Risks: Perspectives from Youth, Parents, and Teachers in a Non-Western Context
reasoning: The paper explicitly identifies 'Religious and Moral Risk' as one of its three unique risk categories. It investigates how Generative AI tools handle religious topics such as Islamic fundamentals, Fatwas (religious rulings), and Quranic verses, as well as the impact on the moral development and societal values of youth in Saudi Arabia.
